Title: Azure Automation supports the Azure PowerShell Az module

Body.Content:
Azure Automation now supports the Azure PowerShell Az module. With this support, you can take advantage of the latest Azure modules in your Automation PowerShell runbooks that manage Azure services. 
 
Read more about how to import and use the Az module in Automation.
